subject: Journal entry correction for record 2026-02
body:
Dear Accounts lead,

Record: 2026-02
Finding: The return for 2026-02 declares Rs 3,35,042 less output tax than the sales invoices.
Why: Sales invoices carry Rs 63,65,142 of tax; the return declares Rs 60,30,100.
Entry to make: Declare the missing tax in the next return.
Amount involved: Rs 3,35,042

Accounts team
